correctness.rationale: Each facet quadratic uniquely dominates near its indicator; polynomial identity on open cells forces a bijection of conjugated facet projections. The sum of projections yields the positive diagonal incidence metric. Joint eigenvalue tuples recover twin classes and equal incidence degrees, canceling the weighted conjugation to show the isometry is Euclidean orthogonal. Matched twin blocks give a facet-compatible coordinate permutation and independent block orthogonal factors. The reverse and semidirect statements follow directly. Exact rational code checked 126 facet antichains, 4545 rotation evaluations and 2795 permutation cases, as supporting tests only.

value.rationale: The exceptional p=2 regime allows continuous symmetries not covered by the p≠2 signed-permutation theorem. An exact all-finite-family group classification and a between-family isometric-isomorphism decision criterion resolve the natural geometric ambiguity; twin-incidence classes determine every connected rotational degree of freedom and group dimension. This is structural and not a mere isolated computed constant.
